items.title: WorkSpaces for AI Agents now available on WorkSpaces Applications image builders
items.summary: Building an AI agent that operates desktop applications includes testing it against your specific applications and desktop configurations. Often, the first goal is a pilot that proves the agent can run your business workload, and you want to reach that point quickly. Starting today, WorkSpaces for AI Agents is available on WorkSpaces Applications image builders. […]
